cohort: The study included 93 pregnant women who had undergone bariatric surgery and 205 obese pregnant women (BMI ≥ 30 kg/m2) hospitalized for delivery.
finding: Pregnant women who had undergone bariatric surgery had a lower occurrence of hypertensive diseases and diabetes during pregnancy, but their newborns were more likely to be small for gestational age.
mod_finding: There were no differences in the frequency of delivery methods between the post-bariatric and obese pregnant women groups.
